name: identity_capability_grants
description: Explicit capability permissions granted to a Person by an owner, in addition to provider-policy grants derived from active links. The language model never creates grants.
lifecycle: Granted and revoked by owners with recent strong authentication; changes reach new access tokens within their 10-minute lifetime. Audited.

columns.Meaning: Registered capability permission such as sales:read; validated against the composed catalog.

columns.Null meaning: Granted by the server-side bootstrap flow.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES identity_persons(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.Purpose: A permission is granted once per Person.
